definition: a golden-green cooking liquid pressed from fruit
description: A sunny olive grove. A young woman with long dark hair, a rust-coloured sleeveless top and a long cream skirt stands barefoot on a wooden crate and pours a thin golden-green stream of olive oil from a clay jug held high above her head. The oil lands on a round crusty loaf held up by a young man in a white linen shirt. She lowers the jug and he lifts the oily loaf to his face and smells it. Olives lie on a net on the ground, a donkey stands behind and pickers work among the trees.
